title: Hop in.
speaker: Elon
description: A fictional Elon caricature introduces the red Tesla Roadster. The two passengers are curious. The sailor monkey waits nearby.

title: Destination: tomorrow.
speaker: Elon
description: The destination is entered on the onboard computer. Keep the established cast and red open-top Roadster.

title: A small correction.
speaker: Monkey
description: The monkey takes the driver's seat and mischievously changes the route. Preserve seating continuity and plausible hands.

title: Questionable driver.
speaker: Passenger
dialogue: Uh... who let the monkey drive?
description: The Roadster accelerates with comic speed lines. The humans react in surprise.

title: The future looks familiar.
speaker: Passengers
description: They arrive in an actual natural monkey habitat: wild trees, vines, rocks and river. All three humans are surprised and slightly frightened. No monkey village, huts, music stages, boats, bunting or human-like monkey activities.

title: Check the route.
description: The computer command is the visual punchline. All three humans are shocked and look at the screen. The sailor monkey alone is pleased. Natural habitat beyond the cabin.

title: Back to basics.
speaker: Monkey
description: The monkey tosses away his sailor outfit. The humans look bewildered, with no smiles. Natural fur-covered animal, no anatomical detail.

title: Home, at last.
speaker: Monkey
description: The naturally fur-covered monkey alone in the Roadster cheers the token name. No humans. Natural habitat, large Tesla T emblem.
